title: Algebraic World Model: From Exploration to Proofs
abstract: arXiv:2610.40503v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI has made remarkable progress in mathematics, solving challenging problems with machine-checkable proofs in Lean, yet typically relying on predefined mathematical definitions and formal specifications. This raises a natural question: can it reason rigorously about an unknown world? We introduce the Algebraic World Model (AWM), a framework that turns interaction with unfamiliar environments into explicit mathematical models supporting formal reasoning. AWM explores the environment and develops executable Python hypotheses, continually testing and revising them against observations. It then structures these hypotheses into typed objects and shared rules, simplifies their structure through category-theory-guided transformations, and formalizes the resulting model in Lean 4 to prove reachability and impossibility. translated_title: 代数世界模型：从探索到证明
translated_abstract: 人工智能在数学领域取得了显著进展，能够在 Lean 中通过机器可验证的证明解决具有挑战性的问题，但这通常依赖于预定义的数学定义和形式化规范。由此产生一个自然的问题：AI 能否对未知世界进行严格的推理？我们提出了代数世界模型（Algebraic World Model, AWM），这是一个将与陌生环境交互的经验转化为支持形式化推理的显式数学模型的框架。AWM 首先探索环境并构建可执行的 Python 假设，并根据观测结果持续测试和修正这些假设。随后，它将这些假设结构化为带类型的对象和共享规则，通过范畴论指导的变换简化其结构，并将所得模型形式化为 Lean 4 代码，从而证明目标的可达性与不可达性。AWM 能够形式化地证明某个目标不可达，即便这超出了已探索的轨迹范围。在两个不可通关的游戏关卡上，它构建……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出代数世界模型（AWM）框架，通过与未知环境交互生成并修正可执行假设，将其结构化为类型化对象并借助范畴论变换进行简化，最终在 Lean 4 中形式化证明目标的可达性与不可达性，实现了从未知环境探索到严格数学证明的跨越。
en_tdlr: The Algebraic World Model (AWM) framework transforms interactions with unfamiliar environments into explicit mathematical models by developing and refining executable Python hypotheses, structuring them into typed objects with category-theory-guided simplifications, and formalizing them in Lean 4 to formally prove both reachability and impossibility, even for goals beyond explored trajectories.
